name: W Koh Samui
positioning: The first W in Thailand: an all-villa beach resort on Koh Samui's north shore where every villa has its own pool, with a hilltop lobby view and a lively night scene
best_for: Couples who want a private pool villa on the beach
Friends and groups who want a large villa and an evening bar scene

facts.text: W Koh Samui is the first W in Thailand.
The beach is swimmable at high or low tide.
The resort was designed by MAPS Design Studio, with interiors by P49 Deesign.
Villa bathrooms have couple's soaking tubs and double sinks.
Guests can have a floating breakfast served in their private pool.
WOOBAR has a nightly fire show and tracks from the W Music Curator.
Namu serves contemporary Japanese cuisine with Asian flavors.
SWING, a sunset tennis court, is available exclusively to guests.
Wellness sessions include Muay Thai, fitness, yoga and Pilates.
Island-hopping trips go to Ang Thong National Marine Park.
Guests can visit Buddhist landmarks such as the 36-foot-tall Big Buddha statue.
The beach area offers kayaks and paddle boards.

highlights.text: Every villa has its own private pool.
From the hilltop lobby, the sea appears to merge with the infinity pool.
The resort's beach faces Maenam sunsets on one side and Bo Phut sunrises on the other.
AWAY Spa offers a Thaimazcal herbal sauna experience, described as Asia's first.
The Grand Residence Pool Villa is a two-story, four-bedroom villa with a beach-view balcony that has an infinity pool.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes a public access road means the beach area isn't completely private.
Conde Nast Traveler says the W's party vibe takes over at night.
Conde Nast Traveler notes some villas are on the beach while others are stepped into an adjacent hill.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: W Retreat Koh Samui
